decision.question: how to stop the refine.js/Refine.js case collision from recurring
options: keep refine.js and just be careful not to overwrite Refine.js again
rename my engine file so the collision is structurally impossible
decision.why: refine.js and Refine.js are the literal same path on any case-insensitive checkout, so every future Windows dev who clones this repo would hit the identical landmine, not just a one-time mistake in this session. Documented the rename and the reason in engine.js's own top comment. Notified task-mastermind-prompt-refine via send_to_agent so any sibling minion told to import ext/Refine/refine.js gets redirected to engine.js.
